privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: ACOMI Privacy Policy
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: 16 August 2026. Operator legal name, registered address, and privacy contact email: [TO BE PROVIDED].

intro.title: Who we are
intro.body: ACOMI is a property operations product for messes, PGs, hostels, co-living, and rentals. This policy describes how the ACOMI mobile app and website (app.acomi.in) handle information. The legal entity that operates ACOMI is [TO BE PROVIDED].

account.title: Account creation
account.body: You create an account with an Indian mobile number and a password. ACOMI stores only a password hash, never the password itself. The same mobile number can register again after account deletion.

dataWeCollect.title: Information we collect
dataWeCollect.body:
Account and profile: mobile number, name, optional email, gender, date of birth, address, profile photo, and identity/address documents you upload.

Operations you run in ACOMI: spaces, buildings, rooms, beds, members, occupancy, meals, payments (including payment proofs you upload), complaints, invitations, and notifications.

We do not collect precise device location, contacts, or SMS content. We do not currently use third-party analytics or crash-reporting SDKs in the app or website.

howWeUse.title: How we use information
howWeUse.body: We use this information to authenticate you, operate your properties, show dashboards, process occupancy and meal workflows, record payment proofs, and handle complaints. ACOMI is not a payment gateway; payment records are operational ledgers and proofs, not card processing.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: People you add to a space (owners, managers, tenants, customers, staff) can see operational information for that space according to their role. We do not sell personal information. Hosting and API infrastructure is used to run the service. Specific subprocessors are [TO BE PROVIDED] if applicable.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Account profile data is kept while the account is active. After you delete your account, personal login data is removed or anonymized. Shared property records may remain because they belong to the business/space, not only to one login. A specific numeric retention period is [TO BE PROVIDED] if you require one for legal reasons.

deletion.title: Account and data deletion
deletion.body: You can delete your account in the ACOMI app (Profile → Delete account) or on this website at /delete-account. Deletion removes your login and personal account information, removes your space memberships, and anonymizes your personal details on linked member records. Spaces, occupancy, meals, payments, and complaints are kept as business records, without your identifiable profile. You can register again later with the same mobile number.
